field.name: fID
field.comment: The ID of the image to be displayed

field.name: fOnstateID
field.comment: The ID of the image displayed while the pointer is over the block (0 or NULL: the image never changes)

field.name: cropImage
field.comment: true: the image is cropped to the maxWidth and maxHeight box; false or NULL: it is fitted in it (SVG images are never cropped)

field.name: maxWidth
field.comment: The maximum width of the image, in pixels (used if sizingOption is constrain_size)

field.name: maxHeight
field.comment: The maximum height of the image, in pixels (used if sizingOption is constrain_size)

field.name: externalLink
field.comment: The URL the image links to: it's used only when internalLinkCID and fileLinkID are 0

field.name: internalLinkCID
field.comment: The ID of the page the image links to (0 or NULL: it links to fileLinkID or to externalLink)

field.name: fileLinkID
field.comment: The ID of the file the image links to (0 or NULL: none): it's used only when internalLinkCID is 0

field.name: openLinkInNewWindow
field.comment: true: the link of the image opens in another window; false: it opens in the same one

field.name: altText
field.comment: The text describing the image, for the visitors that can't see it

field.name: title
field.comment: The text displayed when the pointer stays over the image

field.name: lazyLoad
field.comment: true: the browser loads the image only when it's about to be displayed; false or NULL: it loads it right away

field.name: sizingOption
field.comment: thumbnails_default: the image is sized by the thumbnails of the theme; thumbnails_configurable: by the ones in btContentImageBreakpoints; full_size: it's displayed whole; constrain_size: it fits the maxWidth and maxHeight box

field.name: id
field.comment: The ID of the row pairing a breakpoint of the theme with a thumbnail type

field.name: breakpointHandle
field.comment: The handle of the breakpoint of the theme (used if sizingOption is thumbnails_configurable)

field.name: ftTypeID
field.comment: The ID of the thumbnail type displayed at the breakpoint
